title: Artificial Intelligence Lifecycle
audience: Clinical learners studying AI deployment and monitoring
objectives: Explore how deployed AI model performance changes across data batches.
Connect data drift, validation checks, and retraining decisions.
Practice interpreting accuracy, ROC-AUC, confusion matrices, and predicted probability distributions.

sections.name: Dataset Overview
sections.purpose: Introduce a simulated EHR-style heart disease risk dataset.
sections.how_to_use: Review the sample patient records and the outcome definition before changing model or batch selections.

sections.name: Model Version and New Data
sections.purpose: Compare deployed model versions against incoming batches.
sections.how_to_use: Change the model version and incoming batch. Watch how accuracy, ROC-AUC, the confusion matrix, and predicted probabilities change.

sections.name: Model Drift
sections.purpose: Help learners decide when model monitoring should trigger retraining.
sections.how_to_use: Try Model v1 on later batches, then compare against retrained versions. Use the notes box to record where performance changes.

sections.name: Data Validation Checks
sections.purpose: Show why clinical AI systems need input validation before inference or retraining.
sections.how_to_use: Adjust age, blood pressure, cholesterol, and BMI thresholds. Review which patient rows are flagged.

sections.name: Lifecycle Management Scenario
sections.purpose: Prompt learners to plan monitoring, versioning, documentation, and communication.
sections.how_to_use: Write a short action plan for model versioning, MLflow or DVC-style documentation, and stakeholder communication.

chatbot_guidance: When asked how to use this notebook, tell the learner to start by comparing model versions and data batches.
Explain metrics in clinical language: accuracy is overall correctness, ROC-AUC is ranking ability, and the confusion matrix shows false positives and false negatives.
When learners see drift, connect it to population changes, changing clinical practice, and retraining governance.
